Chitrangada_M.name: Chitrangada
Chitrangada_M.note: Princess of Manipura who wed Arjuna on the condition that their son remain to rule her land; mother of Babhruvahana.

people.Babhruvahana: Son of Arjuna and Chitrangada; king of Manipura. Not knowing his father, he met and slew Arjuna in battle during the horse sacrifice; Ulupi's gem restored him to life.

Chitravahana.note: King of Manipura; father of Chitrangada, he gave her to Arjuna on the pledge that their son would inherit his throne.
